capabilities: Create MOC blocks with a background image in notes
Add and edit markers that link to notes
Store marker data in mocdata folder files
disambiguation: Not a geographic map tool; the 'map' is any background image used to visually arrange links to notes.
extras: Warns that deleting mocdata files or uninstalling the plugin loses marker data; notes the Image Converter plugin breaks block resizing; bugs are tracked on the Git repository.
problem: Obsidian has no built-in way to lay out note links visually on a chosen background image inside a note.

relations.evidence: This plugin is inspired in part by the excellent leaflet plugin

summary: Map-of-content plugin that renders interactive MOC blocks with a background image, note-linking markers, and polylines.
